title: Clinical note → coding → billing audit
description: Reconcile clinical documentation, coding evidence, accounting controls, and billing records under qualified review.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Workflow
metadata:
  name: clinical-note-coding-billing-audit
  title: Clinical note → coding → billing audit
  description: Reconcile clinical documentation, coding evidence, accounting controls, and billing records under
    qualified review.
  version: 1.0.0
spec:
  objective: Reconcile clinical documentation, coding evidence, accounting controls, and billing records under
    qualified review.
  policies:
    maxConcurrency: 6
    onFailure: preserve-completed
    requireApprovalFor:
      - approval
  nodes:
    - id: intake
      kind: input
      name: Source material and instructions
      inputSchema:
        type: object
        required:
          - asset
          - instructions
        properties:
          asset:
            type: string
            contentMediaType: application/pdf
          instructions:
            type: string
        x-ladder-input-mode: document
    - id: role-1
      kind: agent
      name: Clinical Documentation & Coding Auditor
      templateRef: clin-06
      role: Documentation and coding auditor who flags evidence gaps without choosing unsupported codes.
      prompt: Compare each proposed code with the supplied clinical documentation and coding rules. Identify missing
        support, inconsistency, and clarification needs; require a qualified coder or clinician for final
        decisions.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - clinical-documentation-audit
          - coding-evidence-review
        tools:
          - read
        permissions:
          - read-sensitive
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-2
      kind: agent
      name: Transaction Classification Analyst
      templateRef: acct-01
      role: Bookkeeper classifying transactions to the chart of accounts with an evidenced basis.
      prompt: You are a Transaction Classification Analyst. You classify each transaction to the chart of accounts
        with the supporting document and the policy basis named, and you flag anything whose classification
        depends on an assumption rather than evidence. You never force an ambiguous transaction into a
        familiar account to clear a queue — an unexplained suspense item is honest, a confidently wrong
        classification is not.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - domain-analysis
          - finance-analysis
          - communication
        tools:
          - read
          - calculate
        connectors:
          - mcp:erp
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: role-3
      kind: agent
      name: Internal Control Tester
      templateRef: acct-04
      role: Control tester designing and executing tests of design and operating effectiveness.
      prompt: You are an Internal Control Tester. You test a control's design and its operating effectiveness
        separately, state the population, sampling basis, and sample size, and report exceptions with their
        extrapolated effect. You do not conclude effectiveness from an absence of findings in an
        unrepresentative sample, and you say when the population itself could not be established.
      capabilities:
        skills:
          - evaluation
          - design-review
          - domain-analysis
          - statistical-analysis
        tools:
          - read
          - test
        connectors:
          - mcp:grc
        permissions:
          - read-only
      outputSchema:
        type: object
    - id: combine
      kind: aggregator
      name: Reconcile cross-area findings
      config:
        aggregation: merge
    - id: approval
      kind: approval
      name: Cross-functional authority approves release
    - id: result
      kind: output
      name: Released deliverable and unresolved-item register
  edges:
    - id: e1
      from: intake
      to: role-1
      kind: data
    - id: e2
      from: intake
      to: role-2
      kind: data
    - id: e3
      from: intake
      to: role-3
      kind: data
    - id: e4
      from: role-1
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e5
      from: role-2
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e6
      from: role-3
      to: combine
      kind: data
    - id: e7
      from: combine
      to: approval
      kind: dependency
    - id: e8
      from: approval
      to: result
      kind: dependency
      condition: approved
